name: Teemo
title: The Swift Scout

passive.name: Toxic Shot

description.normalized: Attacks deal 8 - 36 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage on impact and an additional 8 - 50 (+9% AP) magic damage each second for 4 seconds.

passive.rawParsedText: Attacks deal 8 - 36 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage on impact and an additional 8 - 50 (+9% AP) magic damage each second for 4 seconds.

q.name: Blinding Dart

description.normalized: Deals 50 / 95 / 140 / 185 (+50% AP) magic damage and blinds the target for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds. Attacks from blinded enemies will miss their target, dealing no damage and failing to apply on-hit effects.

q.rawParsedText:
Deals 50 / 95 / 140 / 185 (+50% AP) magic damage and blinds the target for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds.

Attacks from blinded enemies will miss their target, dealing no damage and failing to apply on-hit effects.

w.name: Move Quick

description.normalized: Passive: Grants 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% Movement Speed if an enemy champion or structure has not damaged Teemo within the last 5 seconds. Active: Rolls a short distance forward and sprints for 3 seconds. During this time, Move Quick's bonus is doubled and cannot be removed by damage.

e.name: Guerilla Warfare

description.normalized: After a delay, become Camouflaged. Moving outside of brush for more than 3 / 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 seconds ends this effect. After exiting Camouflage, gain 30% / 40% / 50% / 60% Attack Speed for 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 seconds. Camouflage: Hide from champions by keeping them out of Teemo's detection radius. Enemy turrets reveal camouflaged units near them. Attacks and offensive abilities end Camouflage early.

r.name: Noxious Trap

description.normalized: Places a mushroom trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing 225 / 350 / 475 (+50% AP) magic damage over 3 seconds and slowing by 30% / 40% / 50% for 3 seconds. Traps last for 2 minutes.
